filter_repo_objects_allow_patterns: filter repo objects using allow_patterns to select items matching glob patterns like *.pdf
filter_repo_objects_ignore_patterns: filter repo objects using ignore_patterns to exclude hidden files matching patterns like .*
filter_repo_objects_with_key: filter repo objects with a key function to extract string paths from custom dataclass instances
filter_repo_objects_folder_pattern: filter repo objects using folder allow_patterns to select items under a specific directory path
filter_repo_objects_default_ignore: filter repo objects using DEFAULT_IGNORE_PATTERNS to exclude .git and .cache directories
